headline: Trump's 'AI Force' Boosts Stock Market Sentiment, New Taiwan Dollar Rises for Third Straight Day - Finance
summary: Asian stocks rose after US President Trump announced an 'AI Force' and said it would not hinder AI development. Taiwan shares opened higher and the New Taiwan dollar strengthened, consolidating near 31.75.
why: Taiwan's stock market is heavily weighted toward semiconductor and AI hardware companies, so policy signals on AI tend to move it. The Taiwan dollar's level affects exporters and capital flows.

impacts.name: New Taiwan dollar
impacts.why: The New Taiwan dollar strengthened against the US dollar on the risk-on move.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Trump's statement that the AI Force would not hinder AI development lifted Asian stocks. Taiwan shares and the currency rose as buying followed the gains.
